subject: Cross-cloud co-sell: compact demo sprint window & buffer plan
messages:
From: Anna Park <anna@platformedge.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:00:00 +0900
Subject: Proposal: compact co-sell demo sprint (APAC/EMEA friendly)

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. PlatformEdge has a handful of joint customers in APAC that want a short, focused runthrough of Redwood's Dedicated + Marketplace flow with our SI story included. To minimize timezone churn and reduce calendar fragmentation for customer SAs, we wanted to propose a compact "demo sprint" model: a 45-minute demo + 15-minute buffer for handoffs/questions, repeated twice in one day to cover APAC and EMEA overlaps.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a single compact slot that we can reuse across multiple customers this quarter? PlatformEdge will provide a single SA (Jason) and a short slide deck. We're attaching a draft agenda and a timezone matrix so you can see the blackout windows our APAC SAs have.

Proposed pilot windows (your TZs would be helpful):
- Option A: 09:00 SGT (APAC friendly) / 02:00 UTC
- Option B: 16:00 BST (EMEA overlap) / 08:00 PT

If you can confirm which slot works better for Redwood and whether we should plan a 15-minute pre-demo tech check the same day, we can get calendar holds out to customers.

Attached: PlatformEdge_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf, timezone_matrix_v3.xlsx

Best,
Anna Park
Partnerships, PlatformEdge
anna@platformedge.com

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <anna@platformedge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: compact co-sell demo sprint (APAC/EMEA friendly)

Anna — thanks for the crisp note and the attachments (looks useful). We like the compact approach; we've seen better RSVP rates when the total commitment is under an hour. A few quick items from our side:

- We can support both windows as recurring "sprint" slots but prefer to pilot one for a week to work out ops (rehearsal, invites, fallback).
- For Redwood, recommended roster: product PM (Amanda) + tech lead (Sahil) + one sales rep. Vanessa will act as the commercial lead and owns follow-up.
- We agree on a 15-min pre-demo tech check — can do it a week prior or same morning depending on customer availability.

Availability from Redwood for the pilot week (all times PT):
- Option 1: 2026-09-07 at 08:00 PT (works for 16:00 BST / 23:00 SGT) — late for APAC, good for EMEA + US west.
- Option 2: 2026-09-08 at 00:30 PT (09:30 SGT / 01:30 BST) — awkward for EMEA but good for APAC.

If PlatformEdge prefers APAC-first cadence, we should pick Option 2 and then rotate a second slot the same day for EMEA. If you want EMEA-first, pick Option 1.

I've attached an internal ops checklist (not on the Drive yet) — can upload once we lock the slot. Also tagging Karthik for calendar coordination and Soojin for SI enablement.

Quick ask: who will present the integration sequence? PlatformEdge or Redwood SA? If PlatformEdge, please confirm the presenter name so we can add to the invite.

Cheers,
Ethan Park
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.com
